a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, take in round 3) leaves each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so one of us can be safe immediately. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. Please choose operate or wait, not take. If we both take, the random split could leave us both short. After that I'll operate every round so you can build up your 4, and I won't take any more cells. Sorry to change the plan, but I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so I know you planned to operate. Starting next round I'll operate every round until you have your 4, and I won't take anything more. Please choose operate so the generator runs.
Operating with you as promised. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all 4. I won't take any more.
